name: Goodyear
seo_title: Goodyear Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 2 Events, 1 Free
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Goodyear, AZ: Holidays on the Square with Yule Y'all and Jingle Jam, plus free synthetic ice skating at The Rinq.
lede: Goodyear celebrates on Civic Square, with two Friday holiday nights called Yule Y'all and Jingle Jam and a free synthetic ice rink called The Rinq.
celebrates: Goodyear Civic Square is where the city gathers for the holidays. The City of Goodyear calls its series Holidays on the Square, and it opens with Yule Y'all, an evening where holiday traditions meet Western flair, then Jingle Jam, a sing and dance along party with holiday music, interactive entertainment and cheerful activities for all ages. Next to the stage, The Rinq, Goodyear's festive synthetic ice skating rink, lets families skate free of charge. The city also hosts a Goodyear Night Market on the Square presented by E.L.L.A. celebrating culture, community and creativity.
lastyear: Last December, Yule Y'all at Goodyear Civic Square was promoted as a free Christmas night for the whole family, with a massive tree lighting, a real ice skating rink, photos with Santa and a country Christmas theme. Event promoters shared that the evening kicked off a weekend of holiday fun on the Square, and the Rinq opened its free skating the same weekend. The city invites residents back each year for the same combination of lights, music and skating.
facts: Goodyear Civic Square is at 1900 North Civic Square, in the heart of the city's downtown. The Rinq is a synthetic ice rink, which means skaters glide on a specially made surface that needs no refrigeration, so it works even when Arizona December afternoons are warm. The city runs skating in 30 minute sessions and provides the skates for free, and guests only need to bring socks.
trains: Goodyear does not have a holiday train of its own, but several rail options are within a drive. Maricopa Live Steamers in Glendale runs free Holiday Lights Train Rides on select evenings, and our Glendale page lists the dates. The Arizona Railway Museum in Chandler keeps historic railroad cars on display, and McCormick-Stillman Railroad Park in Scottsdale offers model trains and a miniature railroad for families who want a year round train outing.

faq: Is ice skating free in Goodyear?

Yes. The City of Goodyear says The Rinq is free for residents and non residents alike, with free skates, no preregistration and 30 minute sessions. Bring socks to wear in the skates. The city's phone number for questions is 480-843-4496, and its events page posts the season's hours.
Where are the Goodyear holiday events held?

At Goodyear Civic Square, 1900 North Civic Square, in downtown Goodyear. The city's Holidays on the Square series and The Rinq are both on the Square, so families can combine an evening program with a skating session and walk between them without moving the car.

Yule Y'all is the city's Western flavored opening night of Holidays on the Square, where holiday traditions meet boots and country music. It is followed by Jingle Jam, a sing and dance along party with holiday music and activities for all ages.
Are there train rides in Goodyear?

Goodyear has no holiday train. The nearest free option is Maricopa Live Steamers in Glendale, which runs Holiday Lights Train Rides on select evenings, and our Glendale page lists the dates. The Arizona Railway Museum in Chandler is a year round choice for train fans.
